'''Swain Import/Export Emporium''' was an art boutique that was located in [[Cjaalysce'I]] on the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Socorro/Legends|Socorro]]. Owned by [[Pret Swain]], it had a reputation of being a place to shop for exclusive, exotic, and rare-to-find items. The Emporium was managed by [[Doctor/Legends|Doctor]] [[Uth Sulrowe]], a [[Mon Calamari/Legends|Mon Calamari]] antiquities appraiser and dealer. Sulrowe appraised customers in the shop, sizing them up because of the Emporium's true purpose; as a front for weapons sales from the [[Caelli-Merced Syndicate]]. If a customer passed Sulrowe's inspection and intuition, they were invited to view the private stock by taking a [[Turbolift/Legends|turbolift]] to an access tunnel underground. A [[Landspeeder/Legends|landspeeder]] ride under the eyes of Caelli-Merced security forces and the clients could peruse Caelli-Merced merchandise including weapons, landspeeders, and [[Swoop/Legends|swoops]].<ref name="BSS" />
